title: Medicare Monthly Enrollment Dashboard WebMCP tools
description: Supplemental discovery catalogue. Live document.modelContext registration is authoritative.

tools.name: get-dashboard-state
tools.description: Get the current dashboard type, selected geography, trend range, and visible table.

tools.name: set-dashboard-type
tools.description: Show either Hospital and Medical enrollment or Prescription Drug enrollment.

tools.name: select-state
tools.description: Select a U.S. state or territory by its two-letter postal abbreviation.

stateCode.description: Two-letter state or territory abbreviation, such as ND or PR.

tools.name: select-county
tools.description: Select a county or county-equivalent by state abbreviation and five-digit FIPS code.

countyFips.description: Five-digit county or county-equivalent FIPS code.

tools.name: clear-geography
tools.description: Return the dashboard to the national geography.

tools.name: set-trend-range
tools.description: Show annual or monthly enrollment trends for the selected geography.

tools.name: show-enrollment-table
tools.description: Show the state or county enrollment table for the current geography.
